answer.text: Private equity, debt/credit funds NOT under Cat I or Cat III

explanation.text: The Logic: Cat II covers PE, real estate, credit/debt funds not under Cat I/III. The Trap: Cat I is VC/infra etc.; Cat III is hedge funds. Cross-Exam Context: Same in XIX-A. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Cat II AIFs have varied risk-return; conduct deep DD per strategy.
